# markup-values: opaque values inside the wrappers and records the exemption layer reads through.
# an element, a formatter's element residue, a one-item flow sequence, an action reference and a
# labelled digest record are syntax around a value; an opaque value in that position is still a
# finding. each line is the twin of a shape in false_positives/markup-element.txt,
# action-tag-ref.txt or go-sum-digest.txt.
# format: <rule id> TAB <line>.
